<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="HGgxUCvzynjRqGD6d1mJ"> <mxGraphModel dx="1791" dy="964" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
skinparam style strictuml
autonumber
actor Distributor
participant \"InvoiceUploadUI : ReactMobileView\" as UI
participant \"InvoiceController : ExpressAPI\" as Ctrl
participant \"AWS S3 : Storage\" as S3
participant \"AI OCR Module : Service\" as OCR
database \"PostgreSQL : Database\" as DB

Distributor -> UI: captureAndSubmitImage(image)
UI -> Ctrl: POST /api/invoices/upload (image, GPS)
Ctrl -> S3: uploadImageObject(image)
S3 --> Ctrl: return ImageURL
Ctrl -> OCR: extractTextFromImage(ImageURL)
OCR --> Ctrl: return JSON(items, quantities, confidence)
Ctrl -> Ctrl: validateConfidenceLevel()
Ctrl -> DB: INSERT INTO invoices (url, data, status)
DB --> Ctrl: confirm Save
Ctrl --> UI: 200 OK (Success)
UI --> Distributor: display \"Upload Successful\"
@enduml",
 "format": "svg"
}" id="bLvvhFlCX3psBY_E-q13-2"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="560" width="1504.26" x="20" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
